description: Converts HTML to readable plain text: drops scripts/styles/comments and all attribute text, keeps paragraph and list structure, separates table cells with " | ", decodes numeric and common named entities, and returns the <title> separately. Input up to 250000 characters; single linear pass. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.
name: html.to-text
title: HTML to plain text
